pinRationale: Deliberately NOT HEAD (which is on Gradle 9.6.0 as of 2026-09). Pinned to the commit that first moved the wrapper to exactly Gradle 8.0, so this repo exercises daemon JDK discovery under a JDK-21 runner the same way Sunflower does: Gradle 8.0 cannot run its daemon on JDK 21. Verified locally: with JAVA_HOME=21, extraction succeeds and extractionMetadata.daemonJavaHome resolves to a JDK 17 found via java_home, not JAVA_HOME. Note: configuring this repo requires a real Android SDK with build-tools 30.0.3 and platform 33 already installed/licensed — the :microbenchmark module's benchmarkReport task fails configuration otherwise. GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runners ship a pre-licensed SDK with common build-tools/platforms, so this is expected to work in CI unmodified.
groundTruthMethod: gradleVersion/androidSdkVersion/androidBuildToolsVersion/moduleCount were confirmed by reading build files at the pinned commit AND cross-checked by running `gradlezilla generate --dry-run --format json` against this exact pinned checkout with a real local Android SDK present. jdkVersion required the verified run to get right: hand-reading android-constants.gradle.kts's signalJavaVersion=JavaVersion.VERSION_11 suggested combining it with AGP 8.0.0's JDK-17-minimum would floor jdkVersion at 17, but the actual resolved value is 11 — extractionMetadata.jdkVersionSource="toolchain" shows gradlezilla found an explicit Gradle/Kotlin toolchain declaration and used it as-is, with no AGP-minimum floor applied on top.

jdkVersion.source: verified run: extractionMetadata.jdkVersionSource="toolchain" — an explicit Gradle/Kotlin toolchain resolves to Java 11 (build-logic/plugins/src/main/java/android-constants.gradle.kts: signalJavaVersion = JavaVersion.VERSION_11); unlike a plain sourceCompatibility setting, an explicit toolchain declaration is NOT floored up to AGP's minimum-required JDK (17 for AGP 8.0.0) — it is used verbatim

androidBuildToolsVersion.source: build-logic/plugins/src/main/java/android-constants.gradle.kts: signalBuildToolsVersion = "32.0.0", read by app/build.gradle's buildToolsVersion — confirmed by verified run; the only one of the five matrix repos that sets this explicitly rather than falling back to an AGP default
